verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses telemetry, usage tracking, or opt-out settings for Lago itself (self-hosted or cloud). The docs cover billing features, AI agents, and self-hosting setup, but nothing about product analytics/telemetry collection or a way to disable it. Missing for 10: any mention of telemetry collection, an opt-out flag/config, or privacy documentation addressing data sent back to Lago.
